title: Training Note — Part-Payment Relief on Late Charges, Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
**What is part-payment relief?**
A relief on the late charge of a past-due fee invoice of an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements, applying where the fee payments applied to the invoice reach a share of the invoice amount: 25 percent where they are half or more of it (50 percent of the invoice amount or more), 10 percent where they are at least a quarter (25 percent) but less than half of it, and nothing otherwise.

**Which amounts are compared?**
The fee payments carrying that invoice's number in the agreement's client money history, against the invoice amount. Fee credits applied to the invoice are not fee payments and do not count toward the share.

**How does the relief act on the charge?**
The reliefs and any adjustment that apply to the late charge are first added into one share, and the charge is reduced once by that share; they do not act one after another, and the result is rounded to the cent once at the end.

## Relief by share paid

| Fee payments applied, as a share of the invoice amount | Relief |
|---|---|
| 0.5 or more | 25 percent |
| at least 0.25, below 0.5 | 10 percent |
| below 0.25 | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

Invoice amount 2000.00 USD.

- Payments applied 1000.00 USD: share 0.5, exactly half — relief 25 percent.
- Payments applied 999.99 USD: below half but at least a quarter — relief 10 percent.
- Payments applied 500.00 USD: share 0.25, exactly a quarter — relief 10 percent.
- Payments applied 499.99 USD: below a quarter — nothing.
- Payments applied 300.00 USD and a fee credit of 400.00 USD: the share counts only the 300.00 USD of payments, 0.15 — nothing.

A charge of 24.00 USD with a relief of 25 percent and nothing else applying is 18.00 USD.
